crossRefs.note: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one word, “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly…
“Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

translations.web: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.
translations.kjv: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, and had great reasoning among themselves.
translations.asv: And when he had said these words, the Jews departed, having much disputing among themselves.
